nodes.asset_description: Full-canvas composite: left side features a cutout portrait of a young woman seated in a relaxed pose, resting her head on her hand, wearing a textured white button-up shirt and light beige pants; soft, neutral lighting. Right side is a light gray, fibrous paper texture panel with a rough, torn vertical edge running irregularly down its left side and subtle grain throughout; small torn highlights along the top-right and bottom-right edges. The beige background color is visible around the textured paper and behind the subject.
